content_sections.heading: About IMSc
content_sections.text: The Institute of Mathematical Sciences (IMSc), Chennai describes itself as a National Institute of higher learning that fosters high quality fundamental research in frontier disciplines of Mathematical Sciences. It runs a teaching programme for the award of M.Sc (by Research) and Ph.D. degrees. The institute is located at 4th Cross Road, CIT Campus, Taramani, Chennai 600 113.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: PhD degree in Physics or Applied Mathematics. Essential experience: Minimum 10 years research experience following PhD. Desirable: Knowledge in simulating complex biological systems involving many coupled differential equations, experience in programming MATLAB scripts. Age limit: 50 years. Educational qualification: PhD degree in Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Applications or Bioinformatics. Experience: Minimum 5 years research experience following PhD. Desirable: Programming experience in Python, Knowledge of 3-d scanning of artifacts. Age limit: 50 years. Educational qualification: MA/MPhil degree in Ancient Indian History. Experience: Minimum 2 years research experience in epigraphy following MA degree. Desirable: Post-graduate course on epigraphy. Age limit: 50 years. Educational qualification: Phd in mathematics. A person who has submitted thesis can also apply. Experience: Nil. Desirable: Research in at least one of the topics among algebraic K-theory, algebraic geometry, commutative algebra, von Neumann algebras, C*-algebras, Classical and abstract harmonic analysis, Operator theory. Age limit: 50 years. Educational qualification: The candidate should have a PhD degree in Physics from a reputed university or institute. Experience: Not required. Desirable: The candidate should have at least two publications in respected journals. Knowledge of statistical mechanics and polymer physics is required. Age limit: 50 years. Educational qualification: Masters degree in Computational Biology or Life Sciences or Allied disciplines or B.Tech. degree in Computer Science. Experience: Not required. Desirable: The candidate should have prior research experience in Life / Environmental Sciences. Knowledge of computer programming is essential. Age limit: 35 years. Educational qualification: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) (or) Master degree in any discipline. Experience: Not essential; one to two years of relevant administrative experience desirable. Age limit: 50 years. Desirable for PA Admin: Master's degree in any discipline, or a degree/diploma in business administration, commerce or office management. Proficiency in e-mail correspondence, good written and spoken English, with the ability to draft letters, minutes and official correspondence; certificates and expenditure statements. Familiarity with basic website or Google Sites/Forms management for registration and announcements. Experience with foreign-visitor formalities (visa support letters, Form C, MEA/MHA conference clearance paperwork), experience with project accounts and settlements, and strong drafting ability in English. The notice states that the prescribed qualifications are minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be considered for shortlisting. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All positions carry a consolidated salary per month that is all inclusive, and the notice states that no other allowances are allowed. Two positions have two pay rates. The Research Associate (Commutative algebra and algebraic K-theory) gets Rs. 54,500/- for those who have submitted the thesis and Rs. 75,000/- for those who have obtained the PhD degree. The PA Admin (Number Theory) gets Rs. 32,500/- for candidates with B.Sc. and Rs. 48,000/- for candidates with a Masters Degree. The positions are proposed to be filled purely on contract basis, initially for a period of one year from the date of appointment. The notice states that there is no scope of regularization or absorption under any circumstances. The engagement will terminate automatically without any notice or compensation, and the admitted candidate shall have no claim of appointment or absorption in IMSc, Chennai.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Pick the project position you are eligible for and note its email ID from the vacancy table above. Write a brief email and attach your Resume. Emails without a resume will not be considered. Write the subject exactly in this form: "Application for the Project Position (Name of the Project Position in Capital Letters) of Advt.06-R/IMSc/2026 dt. 24.11.2026". The notice says the subject is very important for each Project Position. Send the email to the email ID given for that position on or before 2359 hrs on 09.12.2026. Mails sent after that time and date will not be considered. Hard copies of applications or resumes received by hand, post or courier will not be considered under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are screened first. The screened list of candidates will be displayed on the "Opportunities page" of the Institute's website, www.imsc.res.in . Only shortlisted candidates whose names are displayed need to appear for the selection process for their Project position. The selection method differs by position: Scientific Officer D (COE-CSDS), Research Associate (iCEL) and Project Assistant (iCEL): Direct interview of shortlisted candidates. Research Associate (Commutative algebra and algebraic K-theory): Shortlisting and Online Interview. Research Associate and Project Assistant (Computational Biology at IMSc): Applicants will be shortlisted initially based on the requirements of the project, and shortlisted candidates will be interviewed online. PA Admin (Number Theory): Written test and Interview, or a direct interview in case the number of candidates who appear is less than five. The date of the interview, and of the written test for PA Admin, will be announced later. The candidate should produce one copy of valid ID proof with the original (like AADHAR, Driving License, Passport or Voter ID).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Advertisement No. 06-R/IMSc/2026 has 8 project positions: 1 Scientific Officer D, 3 Research Associate, 3 Project Assistant and 1 PA Admin.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed on or before 2359 hrs on 9 December 2026. Mails sent after that will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IMSc PA Admin post?
faq.answer: PA Admin (Number Theory) needs a Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) or a Master degree in any discipline. Experience is not essential, but one to two years of relevant administrative experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IMSc project positions?
faq.answer: The age limit is 50 years for all positions except Project Assistant (Computational Biology at IMSc), which has 35 years. Age is counted as on the last date of submission of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly salary ranges from Rs. 32,500/- (PA Admin with B.Sc.) to Rs. 1,14,500/- (Scientific Officer D). It is all inclusive, and no other allowances are allowed.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IMSc Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email a brief note with your Resume to the email ID given for your chosen position. Hard copies sent by hand, post or courier will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the Project Position (Name of the Project Position in Capital Letters) of Advt.06-R/IMSc/2026 dt. 24.11.2026".

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IMSc project positions?
faq.answer: Screened candidates are listed on the Opportunities page of www.imsc.res.in. Selection is by direct or online interview, and PA Admin has a written test and interview, or a direct interview if fewer than five candidates appear.

faq.question: Q9. Are the IMSc project positions permanent?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely on contract, initially for one year from the date of appointment. There is no scope of regularization or absorption under any circumstances.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate who has only submitted the PhD thesis apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Research Associate (Commutative algebra and algebraic K-theory) position only. Such candidates get Rs. 54,500/- a month, against Rs. 75,000/- for those who have obtained the PhD degree.
